task.description: Hard gate on TEST-DESIGNER's output for REQ-036 (33 tests across 3 files + test/specs/REQ-036.md). Read the spec and all 3 test files independently -- do not trust TEST-DESIGNER's own handoff summary. Verify against REQ-036's actual 6 acceptance_criteria in docs/requirements.yaml and the validated design at lib/letflow/design/promotion_plan.md. Specifically re-check: every compute_promotion_plan/5 call site actually supplies opts[:permission_checker] (grep for calls without it), AC3's test genuinely injects opts[:tenant_classifier] rather than relying on a nonexistent working default, the 2 differently-key-ordered digest examples are genuinely independently constructed (not trivial permutations of the same one-line map), and fixtures use per-test unique tenant data (no shared hardcoded tenant IDs across tests, which would cause cross-test pollution against the real Postgres this codebase's tests run against).
acceptance_criteria: Every REQ-036 acceptance criterion has at least one runnable test that would actually fail if the behavior were violated (not just a test that happens to pass)
No 'TODO: implement test' or skipped test left anywhere in the 3 test files
Test fixtures use per-test unique tenant/data -- verify directly, not on trust
Tests are self-sufficient -- don't depend on other tests running first or on shared mutable state
No hardcoded secrets/connection strings in any test file
Independently re-run MIX_TEST_PARTITION=2 mix test on the 3 new files and confirm the reported 33/33 pass count is real
